Dear Support Team,

I am writing to report an issue I am experiencing with my Thor P2
<http://192.168.68.101/> miner. Currently, the device is only producing *4.8
TH/s*, and diagnostics indicate that only one chip is carrying the hashrate
instead of operating at full cap····.

Here are the current operational details from the web interface:

   -

   *Hashrate:* 4.8 TH/s (out of expected performance)
   -

   *Power Draw:* 155.0 W (Estimated wall power max 240 W)
   -

   *ASIC Temperature:* 46.3 °C
   -

   *VR Temperature:* 73.0 °C
   -

   *Connected Pools:* solo.atlaspool.io <http://192.168.68.101/> (Pool 1)
   and parasite.wtf <http://192.168.68.101/> (Pool 2)

Could you please advise on troubleshooting steps to check or reinitialize
the inactive chips and restore full hashrate performance?

Best regards,

Clovil J.
Note to the team: Handed to Hal.
